The '''sporting blaster rifle''' was a less lethal version of the [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] that was popular with the galactic elite as well as among [[Fringer/Legends|fringers]] living in isolated colonies.

==Description==
The sporting blaster rifle was the [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] version of the [[Sporting blaster/Legends|sporting blaster]] pistol. It was very similar to the [[Hunting blaster/Legends|hunting blaster]]. They were primarily intended for game-hunting on frontier worlds with high wildlife populations.<ref name="Arms & Equipment Guide">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref> They were light, easy to carry, and very accurate. Sporting blaster rifles had a shorter range and packed less power than a standard blaster rifle, though they had the advantage of being more affordable and required less bureaucratic hassle to obtain. As a result of this, the weapon became common with [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] who were able to circumvent the legal restrictions against heavier rifles. Sporting blaster rifles often had a targeting scope mounted on them.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" />

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] kept a [[6-2Aug2 hunting rifle/Legends|sporting blaster rifle]] in his [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> He had also used it to "bullseye womp rats in his [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16]]."<ref name="Revised Core Rulebook" />
